report.tagline: Google's AI lab that turns research breakthroughs like AlphaFold and Gemini into products used by over a billion people.
report.simpleSummary: Google DeepMind is the AI research lab inside Google, based in London. It built AlphaGo, which beat the world Go champion, and AlphaFold, which predicts the shape of proteins and won a Nobel Prize. Today its biggest job is building Gemini, the AI model behind the Gemini app, Google Search's AI answers and many Google products. DeepMind does not sell much itself; it makes Google's products smarter, and Google makes the money.

overview.whatItDoes: DeepMind builds AI models and scientific tools. Its Gemini models power the Gemini app, AI Overviews and AI Mode in Google Search, Gmail, Android and Google Cloud. Its science work, like AlphaFold and weather models, is given to researchers or turned into separate businesses.
howItWorks: Researchers invent new methods, for example reinforcement learning in AlphaGo or protein structure prediction in AlphaFold.
The Gemini team trains large models on Google's own TPU chips in Google data centres.
Product teams across Google ship Gemini inside Search, Android, Workspace, YouTube and the Gemini app.
Developers pay to use Gemini through Google AI Studio and Vertex AI on Google Cloud.
Science projects are released free (AlphaFold Database) or spun into companies like Isomorphic Labs for drug discovery.
Generative tools like Veo (video), Imagen and Nano Banana (images) and Genie (interactive worlds) reach users through Google apps.
overview.valueProposition: For Google, DeepMind turns world-class research into an edge across every product. For users and scientists, it delivers AI that is useful at huge scale, often for free.

painPoints.pain: Working out a protein's shape took years of lab work and lakhs of rupees.
painPoints.howSolved: AlphaFold predicts it in minutes, and the database gives over 200 million structures for free.

painPoints.pain: People want answers, not ten blue links.
painPoints.howSolved: Gemini powers AI Overviews and AI Mode in Search, giving direct answers with links.

painPoints.pain: AI assistants are expensive for many users in India and other markets.
painPoints.howSolved: The Gemini app is free with a strong model; Google ran free AI Pro offers for students and Jio users.

painPoints.pain: Developers need models that read very long documents or videos.
painPoints.howSolved: Gemini models handle around a million tokens of text, audio and video input.

painPoints.pain: Weather forecasts for extreme events are slow and costly to run.
painPoints.howSolved: DeepMind's weather models give fast, accurate forecasts used in Google products.

businessModel.summary: DeepMind is a cost centre inside Alphabet. It earns little directly. Its value shows up as Google revenue: Search ads protected by AI answers, Google One AI subscriptions, Google Cloud AI usage and Workspace plans with Gemini. Science work earns through spin-outs like Isomorphic Labs and through reputation.

revenueStreams.detail: Gemini powers AI Overviews and AI Mode, which keep people searching on Google where ads are shown.
Google AI Pro (about $19.99 or ₹1,950 a month) and AI Ultra (about $249.99 a month) via Google One.
Developers and companies pay per token through Google Cloud.
Gemini is included in Workspace business plans, which helped raise their prices.
Isomorphic Labs drug discovery deals with Eli Lilly and Novartis.

businessModel.pricing: Gemini app: free. Google AI Pro: about $19.99 a month (India about ₹1,950). Google AI Ultra: about $249.99 a month. Gemini API: free tier in AI Studio, then priced per million tokens by model. AlphaFold Database: free.
costDrivers: Training compute on Google TPU chips
Serving Gemini to over a billion app users and billions of Search users
Salaries for thousands of top researchers and engineers
Long research bets with no near-term revenue
businessModel.unitEconomics: Most Gemini app users pay nothing, so each costs Google some compute, perhaps cents per day for heavy users. Google earns it back mainly through Search ads and the share that upgrade. A Google AI Pro subscriber paying $19.99 a month also gets 2 TB storage, so the plan is likely profitable. Google's big advantage is its own TPU chips: it does not pay Nvidia's margins, so each answer costs Google less than it costs most rivals.

growth.moat: DeepMind has three things few others have together: top research talent, Google's own chips and data centres, and Google's distribution to billions of people through Search and Android. A startup can build a good model, but it cannot put it on 3 billion phones or run it as cheaply.

pmLessons: Research is only valuable when it reaches users. DeepMind's impact jumped when Gemini shipped inside Google's products.
Distribution beats being first. ChatGPT launched first, but Google's Android and Search reach helped Gemini pass a billion users.
Owning your cost base matters. Google's own chips make AI cheaper to serve at huge scale.
Give some things away to build trust. Free AlphaFold made DeepMind the most respected AI science lab.
New products can threaten old ones. AI answers can reduce Search clicks, so Google must balance user value with ad revenue.

interviewQuestions.question: How would you decide which DeepMind research project to turn into a product?
interviewQuestions.hint: Score by user need, market size, fit with Google products, readiness and risk. Give an example like AlphaFold to Isomorphic Labs.

interviewQuestions.question: Gemini passed 1 billion monthly users. What metric would you watch next?
interviewQuestions.hint: Move from reach to depth: daily to monthly ratio, tasks done, retention and paid conversion. Explain why MAU is not enough.

interviewQuestions.question: AI Overviews may reduce clicks to websites. How would you balance users, publishers and Google's ad revenue?
interviewQuestions.hint: List each party's goals. Measure user satisfaction, clicks out and ad revenue. Test designs like more source links. Recommend a balanced plan.

interviewQuestions.question: Design a Gemini feature for Indian farmers.
interviewQuestions.hint: Understand users: language, low-end phones, weak internet. Use voice and camera for crop disease and weather. Define success and partners.

interviewQuestions.question: Why might Google give AlphaFold away for free?
interviewQuestions.hint: Reputation, talent, scientific progress, future business through Isomorphic Labs, and data and partnerships. Compare with lost direct revenue.
